Welcome to
Kherajkhat College Website
Kherajkhat College is an emerging institution of higher education in the district of Lakhimpur, Assam. Established in 1982 and affiliated to Dibrugarh University and Madhabdev University respectively, the College has been included under 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act 1956.
The college imparts education in Arts and Science at Under Graduate level in both Assamese and English medium. Fulfilling the long-standing urge and necessity of this bordering region, Science education at Higher Secondary level has been introduced from the current session of 2025-26.
Read More
Principal Message
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to the Kherajkhat College website. We have tried to create an online resource that provides all relevant information about Kherajkhat College and I hope that as you peruse through the contents of this website you will get sense of the rich flavour of life at our college.
Education is life-long learning process, Learning happens all the time, not only in a pre designated place called the college. It happens at the home, between home and college too shaping young impressionable mind which is one of life's biggest challenges at college. We aim to empower our students to grow as individuals with strong discerning minds with an international perspective preparing then to make a mark in the global village - the world has come to be today.
